# November 2025 Development Updates #1


[Reclaim Protocol](https://substack.com/@reclaimprotocol)


Nov 11, 2025


This month at Reclaim Protocol, a major upgrade to our


**Developer Tool (Devtool)** , an important


**Android verification update** ahead of Google Play Instant’s deprecation, and a proud moment as we’re named


**“Startup of the Year”** at the Loyalty & Awards Summit in Amsterdam.


---


**⏳ Important Update: Upcoming Changes to Android Verification Flow (Effective November 2025)**


We’d like to inform you about an important update to the


**Reclaim Protocol Android verification flow** . Starting the week of


**November 4, 2025** , first-time Android users will be


**redirected to the Google Play Store** to install the Reclaim app before proceeding with verification.


This change is necessary as


**Google Play Instant will be discontinued in December 2025** . You can read more about this update on our


[blog](https://blog.reclaimprotocol.org/posts/moving-beyond-google-play-instant) .


We’d like to collaborate with you on a


**phase-wise rollout** of this new flow based on your team’s preferences. Please note that our


**hard deadline for migration is November 15, 2025** .


To help your team prepare, we’ve attached a


**demo video** showcasing the updated flow.


If you’d like to discuss implementation details or align on the rollout roadmap, feel free to


**schedule a call** with our engineering lead


[here](https://cal.com/abdul-reclaimprotocol) .


---


## 🚀 Introducing the New Reclaim Developer Tool


**Build, verify, and deploy trusted data proofs faster than ever**


Last month, we rolled out our brand-new architecture and this month, we’re proud to announce a major upgrade to our


**Developer Tool (Devtool)** - a complete environment for developers to integrate


**verifiable data proofs** into their applications with unprecedented speed and flexibility.


Developers can now choose from over


**21,000 community-built providers** , making it easier than ever to add data verification without building from scratch.


#### 🧩 Build Custom Providers from Scratch


In the latest


[podcast](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wvcZPSiqn5Y) episode, our engineer showcases how simple it is to create your own provider, demonstrated through a live


**Kaggle** example.


Developers can:


-


Capture and analyze real


**network requests** to identify data endpoints.


-


Use


**AI-assisted suggestions** or manual configuration to extract the exact JSON or XML fields they need.


-


Configure


**dynamic URL parameters** , metadata, and login flows to support user-specific data.


-


Add


**JavaScript automation injections** to streamline user navigation and verification steps.


#### 🧠 Smarter, AI-Assisted Workflows


The new Devtool uses


**AI assistance** to guide developers through complex configuration steps, from suggesting API paths to validating response data - making provider creation drastically faster, even for non-engineers with a basic understanding of web requests and JSON structures.


#### ⚙️ Advanced Configuration & Versioning


To ensure accuracy and reliability, the Devtool allows:


-


**Geolocation and user-agent customization** to mimic real user conditions.


-


**Provider versioning** (major, minor, patch) for safe updates and rollbacks.


-


**Version locking in production** , protecting applications from unexpected changes when community providers are updated.


#### 🧰 Debugging, Logs, and Insights


A brand-new


**debugging dashboard** gives full visibility into integration performance. Developers can now view detailed


**session logs** , identify root causes of verification failures, and even receive


**AI-powered fix suggestions** for broken paths or configuration errors.


#### 🌍 Multi-Platform Integration


Once providers are built, they can be integrated across multiple environments via Reclaim SDKs including


**web, iOS, Android, Flutter** , and


**blockchain-based applications** . A unified application dashboard lets teams monitor all integrations, metrics, and proof-generation activity in real time.


The new Devtool marks a major step toward a


**community-driven, scalable verification ecosystem** .


By empowering developers to build and share providers, Reclaim transforms how trusted data moves across the internet, making verifiable user information instantly accessible, private, and secure.


**Try the new Devtool today:**
[dev.reclaimprotocol.org](https://dev.reclaimprotocol.org/)
Join our developer community:


[t.me/protocolreclaim](https://t.me/protocolreclaim)


---


###
🏆 “Startup of the Year” at Loyalty & Awards Amsterdam


We’re proud to share another great news,


**Reclaim Protocol** was awarded


**“ [Startup of the Year](https://www.loyalty-and-awards.com/en/pages/golden-loyalty-awards-winners-195.html) ”** at the


*Loyalty & Awards Summit* in Amsterdam!


This award is a reflection of the growing trust in our mission to build the


**verification and trust infrastructure** powering the next generation of loyalty experiences.


Thank you to our partners, community, and everyone who continues to believe in what we’re building at Reclaim Protocol.
